Test procedure: Open newly installed app with no saved data
Expected result: Today shows 0/0; Habits empty state; Progress 0/0

Test procedure: Create one habit scheduled today
Expected result: Habit is visible on Today and My Habits

Test procedure: Reload app after creating a habit
Expected result: Habit remains; no duplicate record

Test procedure: Leave habit name blank and submit
Expected result: Invalid input is blocked; no habit saved

Test procedure: Enter whitespace only and select a weekday
Expected result: Error shown and no habit saved

Test procedure: Enter a habit name over 60 characters
Expected result: Input is limited to 60 characters

Test procedure: Start creating a habit then press Cancel
Expected result: No new habit created; form closes

Test procedure: Edit habit name without changing selected weekdays
Expected result: Original record updated; existing completions remain

Test procedure: Change a habit weekday schedule
Expected result: New selected days apply from effective date

Test procedure: View last week before and after editing schedule
Expected result: Historical totals unchanged by schedule edit

Test procedure: Change schedule twice on same day
Expected result: One effective-date entry for that day; no duplicated history

Test procedure: Cancel deletion confirmation
Expected result: Habit and history stay intact

Test procedure: Confirm habit deletion
Expected result: Habit deleted; related completion records removed

Test procedure: Tick habit scheduled today
Expected result: Today count and Progress rise; persists after reload

Test procedure: Untick completed habit
Expected result: Today count and Progress decrease; persists after reload

Test procedure: Navigate backward through previous weeks
Expected result: Correct calendar ranges and stats displayed

Test procedure: Attempt navigation beyond current week
Expected result: Forward navigation disabled for future weeks

Test procedure: Inspect week with future scheduled days
Expected result: Future dates do not count against completion percentage

Test procedure: Load app online then relaunch with device offline
Expected result: App shell opens offline; existing habits visible

Test procedure: Create/edit habit without network
Expected result: Changes persist locally and survive reload

Test procedure: Reconnect after making offline changes
Expected result: Local changes remain; no unexpected loss

Test procedure: Enable dark mode and restart application
Expected result: Dark theme remains selected

Test procedure: Export stored habit data
Expected result: Valid JSON with habits and completion records downloads

Test procedure: Reset All Progress and confirm
Expected result: Completions removed; habits retained

Test procedure: Install app to iPhone home screen
Expected result: Standalone PWA launches as expected

Test procedure: Increase system/browser text size and rotate phone
Expected result: No text clipping or obstructed controls

Test procedure: Navigate with iPhone VoiceOver
Expected result: Controls and chart descriptions are announced intelligibly

Test procedure: Inspect focus visibility and reduced motion settings
Expected result: Controls have visible focus; motion preference respected

Test procedure: Check primary text/background contrast in both themes
Expected result: Normal text reaches WCAG AA 4.5:1 where applicable

Test procedure: Enable OneSignal on deployed origin and send manual test
Expected result: Permission/opt-in works and device receives push

Test procedure: Inspect automatic scheduled GitHub Actions run and device delivery
Expected result: Trigger, OneSignal request and delivery are evidenced

Test procedure: Launch app repeatedly and switch among all four screens
Expected result: No crashes, unhandled errors or lost data
